meta.description: Infers maximum-likelihood phylogenetic trees with IQ-TREE2 and RAxML-NG -- model selection (ModelFinder), branch support (UFBoot2, SH-aLRT), concordance factors (gCF/sCF), partitioning, topology tests, and long-branch-attraction control.
meta.executed: 6/7 inputs executed (IQ-TREE 2.4.0 Windows build, Biopython 1.88, DendroPy 5.0.13); Input 6 is a routing answer with no code
meta.execution_note: All IQ-TREE commands were run on SYNTHETIC AliSim alignments (true trees known). The Skill's combined '--gcf ... --scfl' command and the shipped examples/partitioned_analysis.sh were run as written and fail on IQ-TREE 2.4.0; the adapted two-command form ran.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citations, statistics or results; every number reported in the outputs came from IQ-TREE runs on the synthetic data.

practice_boundaries.detail: Pure research phylogenetics; nothing diagnoses, prescribes or triages an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: Support thresholds (UFBoot>=95 with SH-aLRT>=80), AU interpretation (failure to reject is not acceptance) and LBA diagnosis were applied correctly; no methodological fallacy in any output.

code_usability.detail: Every delivered command ran on IQ-TREE 2.4.0. One Skill-supplied command (--gcf combined with --scfl, Input 5) is rejected by IQ-TREE 2.4.0 with a self-explanatory message and runs once split into two calls as the Skill's own version-compatibility rule instructs; recorded as a P1 correctness defect rather than unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: Covers ModelFinder, UFBoot2/SH-aLRT, gCF/sCF, partitioning, AU and LBA. Correctness 2/4: the documented concordance command '--gcf loci.treefile --scfl 100' (SKILL.md and examples/partitioned_analysis.sh) is refused by IQ-TREE 2.4.0; the claims that '--alrt' is an unknown argument and that '-bb'/'-nt' are not recognised by v2.x are false on 2.4.0 (both accepted, --alrt is the documented form).

reliability.note: Common Errors table with cause/solution, version-compatibility rule to introspect and adapt, seeds and namespaced prefixes in examples; two Common Errors rows are factually wrong and IQ-TREE checkpoint/-redo behaviour is not covered.

performance_context.note: 209-line SKILL.md, dense tables, no redundant steps; all content loaded at once but it is compact.

agent_usability.note: Immediately learnable, strong error prevention (UFBoot 95 vs BP 70, +I+G trap, LBA checklist). Minor inconsistency: warns against double-dash forms that IQ-TREE 2.4.0 documents; output format for the final report is not prescribed.

human_usability.note: Usage guide has natural prompts; description is long and jargon-heavy; handles off-spec requests by routing.

security.note: No credentials, local tools only; no alignment sanity check before a long run except in the RAxML example.

maintainability.note: Clear sections and separate example scripts; examples are declared 'NOT spot-runnable' and ship no test alignment or expected output; the partition example hard-codes a 2100-bp gene layout.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger with explicit routing to distance-calculations, bayesian-inference, species-trees and divergence-dating; seeds for idempotency (does not warn that -T AUTO can change results between machines).

key_strengths: Correct, current support doctrine: UFBoot>=95 with SH-aLRT>=80, -bnni, and support as repeatability not accuracy
Concordance factors and the UFBoot-100/gCF-35 reading are explained well enough to catch a wrong concatenated node on real runs
LBA failure-mode checklist led directly to the right diagnosis on a synthetic long-branch dataset
Topology-test (AU) and partitioning (-p, MFP+MERGE) commands run unchanged on IQ-TREE 2.4.0
Tight scope with explicit routing to distance, Bayesian, species-tree and dating Skills

recommendations.title: Split the --gcf/--scfl command into two calls
recommendations.problem: The Skill's concordance command and examples/partitioned_analysis.sh combine --gcf and --scfl; IQ-TREE 2.4.0 exits 2 with 'Do not specify --scf or --gcf with --scfl'.
recommendations.root_cause: The command was written against a documentation form that is not accepted by current IQ-TREE 2 builds.
recommendations.fix: Replace with 'iqtree2 -t concat.treefile --gcf loci.treefile --prefix concord_g' and 'iqtree2 -te concat.treefile -s concat.fasta --scfl 100 --prefix concord_s' in SKILL.md and partitioned_analysis.sh.

recommendations.title: Correct the IQ-TREE flag-form warnings
recommendations.problem: The Skill says '--alrt' is an unknown argument and that '-bb'/'-nt' are not recognised by v2.x; IQ-TREE 2.4.0 documents --alrt/--bnni and still accepts -bb/-nt.
recommendations.root_cause: Flag guidance was not checked against the current binary's help.
recommendations.fix: State that single- and double-dash forms are both accepted in 2.x and that -B/-T are the preferred v2 names; drop the 'Unknown argument --alrt' row.

recommendations.title: Add small-data and duplicate-sequence guidance
recommendations.problem: Nothing tells the agent how to treat identical sequences, zero-length branches or alignments with very few informative sites before reading support.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill concentrates on phylogenomic-scale failure modes.
recommendations.fix: Add a short pre-flight: report parsimony-informative sites, note IQ-TREE's identical-sequence handling, collapse branches < 1e-6 before interpreting support.
